subject: MountainBridge co-sell marketplace — premium listing credit request
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jm@mountainbridge.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.s@mountainbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood marketplace listing + co-sell questions

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. We want to move forward but have a couple of asks before we publish the marketplace listing: 1) MountainBridge needs a short-term promotional credit that offsets onboarding costs for our pilot customers, and 2) we require a co-sell path documented for AWS Marketplace so our sales ops can attribute ARR correctly.

Can Redwood provide a one-time listing credit (we're asking for $40k gross credit applied over the first 3 months) and confirm co-sell support? If needed I can loop in our procurement and legal.

Appreciate a quick read — we are targeting listing next week.

Best,
Jordan Meyers
Director of Partnerships
MountainBridge Analytics

Attachments: MB_REQ_SOW.pdf (proposal stub)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyers <jm@mountainbridge.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.s@mountainbridge.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing + co-sell questions

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks and for the fast timeline. We can support the co-sell path (we have a published AWS Marketplace co-sell process) and I attached a draft marketplace listing checklist. Regarding the promotional credit: that amount is outside standard self-serve listing credits and will need an approval from Deal Desk / RevOps.

Quick plan:
- I attached MB_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf (proposal with proposed credit applied).
- If Deal Desk approves, we can push the private offer with the credit and schedule a joint launch webinar during week 1.
- I can put together the co-sell checklist and attribution steps for your ops team.

Can you confirm the legal billing entity and whether the credit should be a marketplace private-offer credit or a separate onboarding credit? I flagged the urgent timeline — hoping to get internal approval today.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415 555 0187

Attachments: MB_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf (proposal stub), Marketplace_Checklist.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MountainBridge — credit approval request (Deal Desk)

Marissa / Rishi / Sean — forwarding a customer request that just came in. Key points: MountainBridge wants a $40k one-time promo credit to be applied over the first 3 months for their marketplace private-offer pilot. They are ready to list next week and need co-sell confirmation as part of procurement.

Why this matters: MountainBridge is a strategic vertical play in retail analytics; if we can get them public on marketplace now, it unlocks references and a potential co-sell motion with one of our AWS reps. The request is above typical listing concession thresholds for self-serve.

Questions for Deal Desk:
- Is a $40k gross credit (applied as private-offer discount) approvalable under current marketplace concession policy?
- If not full amount, what's the maximum we can approve without executive sign-off?
- Any required gating (SOW, EULA redlines) that would block a private-offer publish?

Attachments: MB_Marketplace_Terms_redline.docx (customer redlines), HubSpot-RDW-9421-link.txt

Notes: customer is requesting fast turnaround today; I suggested a 48-hour window but they are pushing for next-week listing. Thoughts?

—Ben

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MountainBridge — credit approval request (Deal Desk)

Ben — thanks for the heads up and for pulling the redlines together. I discussed with RevOps and finance. Summary and decision: we can approve a concession up to $25k as a structured private-offer credit applied over the first 60 days. The remaining gap ($15k) needs either a partial uplift commitment from MountainBridge (i.e., 12-month minimum committed spend) or an executive-level waiver.

Conditions for approval:
- Private-offer credit of $25k, applied as a billing credit across the first 60 days of consumption.
- Signed private-offer terms (DocuSign) and acceptance of our standard marketplace EULA (no further redlines to the EULA).
- Co-sell readiness call with AWS partner rep scheduled and recorded in our HubSpot deal record (link attached).

Ben — please communicate the approval path to MountainBridge, ask for the spend commit option or indicate they can request an executive waiver (I can escalate if they confirm strategic benefit). If they accept the $25k + 12-month commit, Finance will prepare the private-offer config and I will notify RevOps to publish.

I copied Rishi to confirm there are no other billing constraints on our side. Sean — please prep the co-sell steps and a quick checklist for the ops handoff.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
